text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Under 600 meters to go!
And now, they turn into the final stretch!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (My legs are heavy...! My thoughts are growing dull...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: But――――not yet!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Across the line!! And the winner is—
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ooooooh!! Ikunooooo!!!
You looked so freakin' cooooool!!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno--!! Great job out there----!!!
Nice fight~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...You really gave it your all, Ikuno.
...You're amazing.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh?
Ikuno seems kind of—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: *wheeze*... *gasp*... *cough*... *wheeze*...—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Kh... As expected...
the toll of 2400 meters... is immense...!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (This is bad...! I'm at my limit... just standing—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (————It's no good.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (If I drop to my knees now, I probably won't be able to stand back up.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(We made a promise, didn't we, Ikuno Dictus...!
That I would definitely return to their side! So—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Stand up... and push forward...!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (And use it as fuel...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Today's race... this weight on my body...
It will only forge me into someone stronger...!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! Ikuno Dictus
looks so dignified...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: How should I put it... there's a real sense of stability.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Ngh...—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
............
As I thought, for me to...――

—Seeing Ikuno Dictus after she finished her race,
before I knew it, I was running
straight toward her.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. The toll right after the race was certainly
quite heavy, but I can walk now.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, considering how it's been, as time
passes, the fatigue is bound to surface again..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Let's head back to the waiting room and treat it.
So that it doesn't leave any lasting effects.

"...2,400 meters. Being 800 meters longer than the Oka Sho,
this distance is undoubtedly brutal for an Umamusume
in the spring of her Classic year."
Especially for the Umamusume running the Triple Tiara, it truly drives home just how immense of a toll this 2,400-meter race takes on them—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
............Thank you very much,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The promise I made with you, Trainer...
It's what kept me going right after the race.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And even now... having you worry about me
like this gives me such great strength—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Running the full 2,400 meters
has given me another boost of confidence.
Confidence that I can run even further."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to get even stronger from now on.
So... I look forward to working with you.
—I'm always the one who draws strength from you.

If anything, I'm the one who's always being saved
by Ikuno Dictus's inner strength...
choice_data_list: …Thank you for coming back safe and sound

text_block_list.text: ...And so, Ikuno Dictus achieved great results in the longest leg of the Triple Tiara—

—After that, while receiving first aid in the waiting room,
her friends came by, worried sick about her.

Once it was clear that Ikuno Dictus was okay for now,
her friends offered their congratulations as well—

It seemed to offer great encouragement
to Ikuno Dictus, who had just finished
a fiercely contested race...
...Afterward, we had a thorough medical examination done that day, and after confirming that there were no immediate issues, we headed back to the Academy—

The next day.
At the meeting utilizing "IRON WILL"—

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"Severe fatigue accumulation confirmed, centered in the legs.
We recommend taking a rest without undergoing hard training for a while."

choice_data_list: I'd like to hear your opinion on entering the Shuka Sho.
Tell me your thoughts on entering the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"‘Understood. Entering the Shuka Sho
still carries significant risks.’"

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"Ikuno Dictus's abilities as an Umamusume
are currently still developing. And that holds
true for her peers in the same generation as well."

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text: “An increase in racing capability directly leads to more intense race dynamics. In proportion, the required performance for victory is also elevated.”

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text: “While the Shuka Sho is 400m shorter than the Yushun Himba, taking into account the growth of the participating Umamusume, there is no significant difference in physical strain.”

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text: "Depending on race pacing and track conditions, there is a very real possibility this could become a harsher race than the recent Yushun Himba."

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"Therefore, I would like to propose a new racing plan to mitigate risks.
Please look it over."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...What are your thoughts on this, Trainer?

...What 'IRON WILL' said
was certainly not wrong.

Much like last year's Oka Sho Umamusume, lately many Umamusume
who perform well in the Classic races
end up getting injured during their Classic Year.

I hate to call it a jinx, but...
it really just goes to show how brutal the Classic races truly are.

Yet I'd known it from the start. I'd already made up my mind.
We would stand against such harsh reality together, using careful maintenance and management.
And yet—

—I couldn't shake the image of Ikuno Dictus
looking in such pain right after the Oaks...

Ikuno Dictus told me that keeping the promise
she made to me helped keep her going. And yet—

I can't help but imagine it.
The "worst-case scenario."

A future where she collapses just like that...
and can never run on the turf again.

...In Ikuno Dictus's eyes, the same unwavering light of determination flickered today.
Facing that brilliant gaze, I—
choice_data_list: ...I respect what you are aiming for.

text_block_list.text:
Desperately pushing down the "worst-case scenarios" in her heart,
she put her unyielding, true feelings into words.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —I want to run in the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I want to push through while fully aware of the risks,
and reach even greater heights.
...That resolve of mine will never change."
choice_data_list: ...Alright. Let's aim for the Shuka Sho as planned!

text_block_list.text:
And so, as originally planned,
our next target race became the Shuka Sho—
――A few days later.

I was watching the Japanese Derby live on-site
alongside Ikuno Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Now leading on the inside is Ines Fujin!
How is Mejiro Ryan's late charge looking?!
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Reach it... Reach, reach, reeeaaach!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Mejiro Ryan, charging in!!
Mejiro Ryan! Mejiro Ryan!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
—Everything.
With all I've got...!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'll give it everything I've gooooot!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wha-?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —Ines Fujin crosses the finish line!!
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Amazing—
—I knew it by intuition.
That the Umamusume known as Ines Fuujin had poured out every ounce of her strength... and even everything beyond that—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
*Haah*... *haah*... *haah*...—
Aha... my legs... won't move anymore...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —Ines!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay?! 
Are you hurt anywhere—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
............Lean on my shoulder.
Everyone is waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Everyone...?

(—I-NES! I-NES!
I-NES! I-NES!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...A-Ahaha... I'm not in the
Winner's Circle yet, you know?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: And yet... everyone...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Ines.
And... congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ryan-chan...

(I-nes! I-nes!
I-nes! I-nes!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...They seemed to be having fun.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
On the final stretch, Ines was running ahead looking so joyful.
...Almost dazzlingly so.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"It was truly magnificent...
As an Umamusume myself...... I can't help but look up to it."

(I-nes! I-nes!
I-nes! I-nes!)

The venue fills with emotion and fervent excitement.
The world trembles with cheers praising the victor.
Surrounded by such blessings, I—
Seeing Ines Fujin slowly walking over while supported by Mejiro Ryan stirred up complicated feelings...

—Time ticks on relentlessly toward the final showdown of the Triple Tiara,
the "Shuka Sho."
Leaving no bit of glory, or its shadows, behind.
